generator.params.needle_years.why: A shoot keeps its foliage as long as its needles or scale leaves live.

generator.params.cone_years.why: A cone is drawn from its first season on the tree until it falls: the seasons it takes to ripen, then the years it hangs on once ripe.

generator.params.cone_pitch.why: Degrees down from its shoot: a negative pitch stands a cone up.

appearance.organs.*.shape.bundle.why: A pine's needles in their bundles.

appearance.organs.*.shape.needle.why: A spray card draws its needles a share of its length, and a usual spray is about a fifth longer than the shortest shoot's (spray_base), measured over the conifers' cards at 60 years: so the usual needle is the stated one, up to the 0.4 a card holds.

appearance.organs.*.shape.ranks.why: Needles out all round the shoot, or in two flat ranks.

generator.program.note: The conifers' own program (growth plan G2.3a), renamed from `conifer` and homed here: a leader laying down whorls of branches each year, with sprays of foliage and cones.

rules.note: Spec rework E6d: the pinidae program's foliage life, cones and needle bundles and ranks from each taxon's stated characters.
